Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Shadows within Shadows
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Obfuscate / Obtenebration
[obf] This vampire burns 1 blood to get +1 stealth.
[obt] As [obf] above.
[obf][obt] +X stealth, where X is the number of levels of Obtenebration and Obfuscate this vampire has. Stealth can't be reduced this action.

Having obfuscate and obtenebration is redundant and means usually that one of the discipline is not used. There are 17 vampire with both. Most of them already have access to Lost in Crowds or Forgotten Labyrinth, so the game won't be unbalanced by Shadows within Shadows, especially with the burn blood part at inferior of each discipline.
I thought it would be nice to give a bonus to vampires with both, so maybe we see them more often.

Messages.Author: glaswanderer
Messages.Body:
Blood cost on a card usually reflexs the superior use of the card. The cost on EI makes the block fail, and FL gives 2 additional stealth on non-bleed actions.

Possible new version:

Shadows within Shadows
Action Modifier
Obfuscate / Obtenebration
[obf] +1 stealth.
[obt] This vampire burns 1 blood to get +1 stealth.
[obf][obt] This vampire burns 1 blood to get +X stealth, where X is the number of levels of Obfuscate and Obtenebration this vampire has. Stealth cannot be reduced during this action.

Prince of Puyallup

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
This is one of those "good ideas" that needs a lot of restrictions to make it balanced. But it's a neat idea!

The two inferiors are neat, but you really need to make the superior say something like "Not usable on a bleed or political action." because Forgotten Labyrinth is already gross enough. You could probably also add "This card may not be played if the action's stealth is currently greater than 1."

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> agzocgud wrote:
> Why does  cost one blood? Paying for obf-stealth doesn´t make sense. Otherwise, I like the card.
>
I didn't want it to be an autoinclude for decks that rely on stealth diversity, but still be usable for the sidekicks.

I like glaswanderer's version, though I'd keep it free at "superior", or make the whole card cost 1 blood so it can be reduced by a path of night or what else.

> KevinM wrote:
> but you really need to make the superior say something like "Not usable on a bleed or political action." because Forgotten Labyrinth is already gross enough. You could probably also add "This card may not be played if the action's stealth is currently greater than 1."
>
There is already a major restriction: you need to have both disciplines (17 vampires in the game, that's not a lot). Adding another restriction makes no sense, because players won't bother to play both disciplines to achieve the same effect as a card that requires only one of the two disciplines (Forgotten Labyrinth for instance).
